headline: The cross-ticker read stays constructive overall, but today still looks selective rather than a broad clean risk-on continuation.

30d.thesis: The operating stack is still constructive: Q1 FY2027 revenue and Q2 guide remain exceptional, the NotebookLM briefings still frame agentic-AI and hyperscaler-capex demand as durable, and today's Palantir sovereign-AI / Nemotron news reinforces NVIDIA's push beyond pure GPU supply into a wider trusted-runtime platform. But the newly weaker Mytutopia reading and the still-live supplier-capture debate argue for a measured, not heroic, 30-day bull case.
drivers: continued Blackwell deployment and Rubin visibility
whether software, networking, and sovereign-AI attachments broaden the value-capture story beyond accelerators alone

falsifiers: persistent evidence that suppliers capture more of the market's upside than NVDA itself
AI monetization or capex skepticism driving broader multiple compression

90d.thesis: Over a quarter, the more important drivers remain structural: Blackwell production, Rubin roadmap credibility, software/runtime attachment, and continued AI-infrastructure buildout. The delayed RSI/VEL5 weakness matters mostly as a confidence cap rather than as a thesis breaker at this horizon.
drivers: customer evidence that Blackwell and Rubin are translating into real deployments
durability of hyperscaler, sovereign, and enterprise AI demand
conversion of memory/networking readiness into NVIDIA-recognized revenue and margins

falsifiers: evidence that the AI spending cycle is still large but NVIDIA captures a smaller share of the incremental economics
material export-control or geopolitical tightening that narrows addressable demand
continued equity underperformance despite positive ecosystem evidence

1y.thesis: The 1-year case remains constructive because NVIDIA still owns the broadest AI platform across accelerators, CPUs, networking, inference/runtime software, and AI-factory systems. Today's Palantir sovereign-AI linkage, the standing Rubin/Blackwell roadmap, and large buyback capacity reinforce the long-horizon moat more than the short-horizon technical weakness detracts from it.

durability of hyperscaler and sovereign AI capex

falsifiers: structural margin squeeze from power, packaging, or memory bottlenecks

credible evidence that open-model / custom-silicon ecosystems reduce NVIDIA's share of the long-run value stack

IBM gives earnings resilience, DUV recovery broadens the story beyond pure EUV, and High-NA plus long-cycle AI / memory buildouts preserve significant upside. Mytutopia is only supplementary here; negative VEL5 argues for humility on path, not for reversing the structural thesis.
